images.prompt: Create a production-quality Chinese interaction design specification board, target 1800x1200 landscape. Follow attached Workflow OS visual reference: warm ivory, forest green, ink text, restrained Song serif headings and clean sans-serif controls, fine dividers, no gradients or decorative cards. This is a single coherent component-state board, not an app screenshot or alternatives. Heading 常用控件 · 交互状态. Subtitle 视觉反馈与业务结果分别表达. Top show narrow complete Windows titlebar: back, disabled forward, search Ctrl K, + 新建任务, blank drag area, minimize maximize close. NO Relay Agent title text. Main wide comparison table with columns 默认, 悬停, 按下, 键盘聚焦, 不可用, 提交中. Row of same 保存新版本 button each state: green default, subtly lighter hover with mouse pointer, darker pressed no checkmark, independent visible outline focus, muted disabled with visible reason 暂未取得编辑权, loading button text 保存中 and stable width. Below show two focused strips: navigation hover 今日 light tint versus selected 项目 with green vertical line and bold; version tabs v3 当前选用 and v2 正在查看 demonstrating these are separate. Bottom a focused editable field labeled 修订说明 with focus outline, and invalid field with inline error 请填写修订说明. Small footer 静态交互示意 · 2026-09-29 · 数值以项目 tokens 为准. Legible Chinese, careful spacing, sparse and professional.

Generate a Chinese Workflow OS interaction storyboard, target1800x1200 landscape, same warm ivory forest green editorial design as attached reference. Single coherent flow about version acceptance, heading 版本验收 · 每一步都有明确回执. Narrow Windows titlebar left back forward 搜索 Ctrl K +新建任务 blank draggable middle and minimize maximize close, NO Relay Agent text. Four equal vertical panels on shared surface divided by thin lines, large readable text, no nested cards. First 核对版本: 文献综述 v3, 验收依据 v2, 当前检查有效, primary 接受 v3 并完成 with subtle hover and mouse pointer. Second 提交中: same document and criteria, primary disabled 提交中, 已发送请求，等待回执, no success check. Third 结果待核对: amber small symbol, 暂时无法确认提交结果, primary 核对原请求, 禁止重复接受; original version context retained, no generic retry. Fourth 已确认完成: restrained green check, 任务已完成, 已接受：v3, secondary 查看完成记录, this is only after business commit confirmed. Thin arrows show first to second, second branches to third if no receipt, from third after confirmation to fourth. Bottom distinct stale evidence branch: 版本或验收条件变化 → 原检查失效 → 重新核对, disabled 接受 v3 并完成 and visible reason 验收依据已变化. Footer 静态交互示意 · 2026-09-29. All text exact concise clear Chinese, modest heading, whitespace. No invented IDs, no confetti, no automatic accepted state from click.

Create one precise Chinese interaction storyboard for Workflow OS, 1800x1200 landscape. Follow attached warm ivory forest green restrained editorial style. Heading 人工接手 · 执行权确认后再编辑. Top Windows titlebar left back forward search Ctrl K +新建任务 blank drag area right minimize maximize close; NO Relay Agent name. Three wide sections with thin vertical dividers and arrows: AI 执行中 (当前执行者：AI, latest output readonly, green 请求接手 with hover mouse cursor); 等待安全交接 (已提交接手请求, 当前执行者：AI, 正在等待在途动作安全结束, disabled 编辑正文 with reason 尚未取得编辑权, supporting 查看执行记录); 已确认接手 (当前执行者：人工, 已完成安全交接, visible enabled text editor showing 可继续修订文献综述, green 保存新版本). Explicit labels arrows 请求已受理 and 交接已确认 distinguish receipts. Beneath separate amber side-branch panel 外部动作结果待核对 with message 保持只读，先核对原动作 and single 核对执行结果 button. This is exceptional branch from waiting, not normal required stage. Bottom compact note 已暂停 ≠ 已接手：暂停后执行者仍为 AI，编辑权须单独确认。 Footer 静态设计示意 · 2026-09-29. No fake percentages, no elapsed deadline implying success, no unrequested operations, no multiuser, no graphs. Chinese must be readable, no long narrative paragraphs.
